root.name: テレダイン・テクノロジーズ

rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: Ampriusが、電池の長年の顧客・パートナーとしてTeledyne FLIRを挙げる
relations.text_en: Amprius lists Teledyne FLIR among long-time battery customers and partners

source.label: Amprius 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our batteries and their performance specifications have been tested and validated for application by various customers, including our longtime partners such as AALTO Airbus, AeroVironment, BAE Systems, Kraus Hamdani Aerospace, Teledyne FLIR and the U.S.

relations.text: Mobilicomが、提携先・顧客の一社としてTeledyne FLIRを挙げる
relations.text_en: Mobilicom lists Teledyne FLIR among its partners and customers

source.label: Mobilicom 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Our partners and customers include Israel Aerospace Industries, Airbus, Teledyne-Flir, Rafael Technologies, ST Engineering, the Israeli Ministry of Defense, or MOD, U.S.

relations.text: SiTimeのMEMS製品の主要な製造委託先(ファウンドリ)の一社
relations.text_en: One of SiTime's primary foundries for its MEMS timing devices

source.label: SiTime 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: and Teledyne Digital Imaging Inc. ("Teledyne") in Canada as our primary foundries and suppliers for our MEMS timing devices and analog mixed-signal circuit ICs.

companies.name: バイオナノ・ジェノミクス

relations.text: Teledyne MEMSがBionanoに部品を供給する契約
relations.text_en: Supply agreement under which Teledyne MEMS sells to Bionano

source.label: Bionano 10-K添付の供給契約
source.quote: by and between Teledyne MEMS , a business unit of Teledyne Digital Imaging, Inc.

relations.text: Brukerの一部門が赤外線検出器を単独の供給元としてTeledyneから購入
relations.text_en: A Bruker unit buys focal plane array detectors from Teledyne as its single supplier

source.label: Bruker 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: it purchases focal plane array detectors from a single supplier, Teledyne Scientific & Imaging.

relations.text: 光学システムと防衛電子の事業(Qioptiq)を2025年2月に買収
relations.text_en: Acquired the Qioptiq optical systems and advanced electronics businesses in February 2025

source.label: Teledyne 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the Optical Systems and Advanced Electronics Systems ("Qioptiq") businesses, which were acquired on February 3, 2025

companies.name: オーシャン・パワー・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: Teledyne MarineとOEM契約を結び、センサーを自社の無人海洋機器に組み込む
relations.text_en: OEM agreement to integrate Teledyne Marine sensors into its autonomous platforms

source.label: Ocean Power Technologies 10-K(2025年4月期)
source.quote: In June 2024, we executed an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) agreement with Teledyne Marine.

relations.text: AeroVironmentが10-Kで、無人機の主な競合の一社としてTeledyneを挙げる
relations.text_en: AeroVironment names Teledyne among its principal UAS competitors

source.label: AeroVironment 10-K(2026年4月期)
source.quote: Our current principal competitors include Elbit Systems Ltd., Quantum-Systems, Inc., Redwire Corporation, Teledyne Technologies, Inc., Sierra Nevada Corporation, Lockheed Martin Corporation, The Boeing Company, Textron, Inc., Shield AI, Inc., Northrop Grumman Corporation, Griffon Aerospace, Inc., L3Harris Technologies, Inc., Anduril Industries, Inc., Airbus SE and Israeli Aircraft Industries.

relations.text: Garminが10-Kで、船舶向け製品の主な競合としてRaymarine(Teledyne)を挙げる
relations.text_en: Garmin names Raymarine (Teledyne) among principal marine competitors

source.label: Garmin 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: For marine products, Garmin believes that its principal competitors are Furuno, Johnson Outdoors, Navico (Brunswick), and Raymarine (Teledyne).

relations.text: Xylemが10-Kで、計測・制御部門の主な競合の一社としてTeledyneを挙げる
relations.text_en: Xylem names Teledyne among key competitors in measurement and control

source.label: Xylem 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our key competitors in the Measurement and Control Solutions segment include Badger Meter, Echologics (Mueller Water Products), Hach (Veralto Corporation), Itron, Kamstrup, Landis+Gyr, Neptune (Roper), and Teledyne.

companies.name: ミリオン・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: Mirionが10-Kで、原子力・安全分野の主な競合としてFLIR(Teledyne)を挙げる
relations.text_en: Mirion names FLIR (Teledyne) among primary nuclear and safety competitors

source.label: Mirion 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Nuclear & Safety: Thermo Fisher Scientific, Curtiss-Wright, Ortec (Ametek), FLIR (Teledyne), Ludlum, Fuji Electric, Caen System, Fluke (Fortive), Berthold Technologies and Framatome

relations.text: Ralliantが10-Kで、計測部門の主な競合の一社としてTeledyneを挙げる
relations.text_en: Ralliant names Teledyne among main test and measurement competitors

source.label: Ralliant 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In the Company's Test and Measurement segment, its main competitors include Keysight Technologies, Rohde & Schwarz, Ametek, and Teledyne Technologies, among others.

relations.text: 908 Devicesが10-Kで、大手競合の一社としてTeledyneを挙げる
relations.text_en: 908 Devices names Teledyne among large competitors

source.label: 908 Devices 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We face substantial competition from very large and experienced enterprises, both public and privately held, including Agilent Technologies, Bruker Corporation, Inficon, Teledyne, Thermo Fisher Scientific and Rigaku.

companies.name: バレックス・イメージング

relations.text: Varexが10-Kで、産業用X線検出器の競合の一社としてTeledyneを挙げる
relations.text_en: Varex names Teledyne among competing industrial detector suppliers

source.label: Varex Imaging 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: In the low-energy sector of our Industrial segment, we compete with other OEM suppliers, such as iRay, Teledyne, and Comet AG

relations.text: AIROが10-Kで、小型無人機の主な競合の一社としてTeledyneを挙げる
relations.text_en: AIRO names Teledyne among principal small-drone competitors

source.label: AIRO Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our current principal sUAS competitors include Elbit Systems Ltd., Teledyne Technologies, Inc., L3 Technologies, Inc., and Lockheed Martin Corporation.
